measurementBoundary.packagePreparation: EXCLUDED: local directories are packed before install timing; supplied tarballs are reused
measurementBoundary.install: npm install into a new empty root with --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --package-lock=false
measurementBoundary.invocation: installed package manifest bin -> Node launcher -> MCP stdio; Rust wrapper may spawn a native child
measurementBoundary.startup: spawn() call until the operating system child spawn event; excludes npm install and package preparation
measurementBoundary.initialize: MCP initialize request write after spawn event until matching response
measurementBoundary.coldCall: first tools/call for that tool in a fresh installed-package MCP process
measurementBoundary.coldBoundary: wall time from spawning a fresh installed-package MCP process through its first successful tools/call response
measurementBoundary.warmCall: 5 subsequent tools/call request/response samples in the same process
measurementBoundary.coldSampling: 3 paired fresh-process samples per tool with alternating Rust/JavaScript order
measurementBoundary.runtimeState: each engine session receives a distinct empty HOME, USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, XDG directories, and WEAVATRIX_GRAPH_HOME
measurementBoundary.memory: peak sampled resident working set summed over the launcher process tree; sampler is outside that tree

runtimeNetwork.enforcement: best-effort environment policy, not an operating-system network namespace
runtimeNetwork.details: offline flags and non-routable proxy variables are set; the harness itself performs no runtime network requests

excluded: cross-engine output equality (this benchmark checks boundary success and invariants)

execution.ordering: paired by tool and cold sample; first engine alternates globally between Rust and JavaScript
